title: Discovery readout — Acme Co.
subtitle: Findings from the Q2 personalization workshop, plus the recommended next 90 days.

sections.text: Across five sessions with marketing, IT, and digital leadership, three themes came up in every room: personalization is stuck at the landing-page layer, cross-channel orchestration takes weeks to ship, and AI investments to date haven't moved a metric anyone tracks.
67% of in-flight personalization work today lives outside any orchestration platform. That's where the 'weeks to launch' lives.
Personalization stalled at the landing-page layer.
The current toolset reaches first-touch conversion well. Below that — email follow-up, in-app messaging, paid retargeting — the experience reverts to batch. Customers feel the seam.
One change to a segment ripples through five tools. Each tool owns its own copy of the customer. Each takes a different SLA to update.
Two vendor pilots delivered model accuracy improvements but couldn't tie them to outcomes that the CMO tracks. The CFO has paused new AI funding pending demonstrable revenue lift.

items.text: Stand up Adobe Real-Time CDP with the three highest-value data sources.
Migrate the top 10 marketing segments to Real-Time CDP and retire duplicates.
Connect to existing email and web personalization tools.
Choose the abandoned-cart-to-renewal journey as the pilot.
Use Adobe Journey Optimizer to deliver decisions in real time across email, push, and web.
Connect Adobe Customer Journey Analytics to the pilot journey.
Define the three KPIs the CMO will use to greenlight phase 4.

sections.text: Conservative model: 12 weeks to first measurable outcome. Stretch model: 8 weeks if data sources are clean.

items.text: Confirm the data sources for Phase 1 by Friday.
Schedule the technical architecture review for the following week.
Adobe Solutions Consulting will draft the statement of work after data sources are confirmed.
